calls.statement: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) AS n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_key, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.channel_code) AS cc, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' OR s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group='web')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, SUM(r.returns_net) AS rpt_ret, count(*) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*) AS orders, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS dist_orders, sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order x WHERE x.status=o.status)) AS lines
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-01' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-15' GROUP BY o.status

SELECT 'web lines w/o dispatched order' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup web order ids', count(*)-count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup return ids', count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup returns per sales line', count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'test web lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.category='ZZ Test' AND s.store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'test web returns', count(*) FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.category='ZZ Test' AND s.store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines with ST code', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.channel_code='ST'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web returns total in FY25/26 P5-8 booked to non-900 stores for web lines', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s1 ON s1.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s1.store_id=900 AND s2.store_id<>900

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS test_net, count(*) AS n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE p.category='ZZ Test' AND s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS instore_returns_of_web_lines, count(*) AS n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s1 ON s1.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE s1.store_id=900 AND s2.store_id<>900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
